text.content: So in light of the above, I feel that it might be about the level of engagement in a real market, and the question is how much it pays off. Real money PMs force you to have a rather high engagement, because of stakes and adversaries. We want people who are really into the weeds (but also it gets us into unsafe “inside view” territory and further away from “base rates” territory).
